ARQ.reason: A couple wakes to the same home invasion night after night, and every loop lets them see a little more.

Phase IV.reason: Ants in the Arizona desert start acting like they're working from a plan.

REC.reason: A news crew embeds with firefighters on a routine call, and the building gets sealed behind them.

Personal Shopper.reason: A woman starts receiving texts from someone who knows details only her dead brother would.

Skinamarink.reason: Two kids wake at night to find the windows and doors of their house have quietly disappeared.

Climax.reason: A dance troupe's wrap party goes sideways once someone spikes the sangria.

Possession.reason: A crumbling marriage in Berlin turns into something that stops looking like a marriage at all.

Sputnik.reason: A cosmonaut returns from orbit carrying a passenger no one signed off on.

Synchronic.reason: A street drug turns out to be a genuine door through time, with no instructions for getting back.

Monolith.reason: A disgraced journalist's podcast about a mysterious black brick turns up the same object all over the world.

Phenomena.reason: A girl who can communicate with insects is sent to a Swiss boarding school with a killer nearby.

The Lighthouse.reason: Two keepers, one rock, and a light neither of them is allowed to look at.

Devil.reason: Five strangers trapped in a stalled elevator start dying one at a time, and one of them isn't human.

Us.reason: A family's beach vacation ends when their exact doubles show up in the driveway.

Europa Report.reason: A crewed mission to one of Jupiter's moons finds exactly the kind of life it was hoping for.

The Infinite Man.reason: A man builds a machine to perfect one weekend with his ex, and immediately over-engineers it.

Relic.reason: Three generations of women share one house, and the house is starting to change.

Edge of Tomorrow.reason: A soldier dies on an alien beachhead and simply wakes up at the start of the same battle.

El Topo.reason: A gunfighter's quest for enlightenment turns the desert into one long unexplained allegory.

Nope.reason: Something in the sky over a ranch feeds on being seen.

Fire in the Sky.reason: A logger vanishes for five days, and what he describes afterward is worse than anyone believed.

Exam.reason: Eight candidates for a corporate job are locked in a room with one blank question and one impossible rule.

Communion.reason: A writer's cabin retreat turns into a series of visitors he can't explain to his family.

Resolution.reason: A man tries to sober up his friend in a cabin, and the cabin starts editing reality.

His House.reason: A refugee couple's new home has followed them from the place they escaped.

Berberian Sound Studio.reason: A mild-mannered sound engineer dubs foley for an Italian horror film and can't tell where the studio ends.

Moon.reason: A lone miner nearing the end of his contract finds out he isn't as alone, or as singular, as he thought.

Aniara.reason: A routine shuttle to Mars loses its way, and the ship just keeps drifting.

The Platform.reason: A vertical prison feeds its levels from the top down, and there's never enough left by the bottom.

Timecrimes.reason: A man discovers a time machine and immediately makes his own situation worse.

Looper.reason: Hired killers are occasionally sent their own future selves to execute.

Antiviral.reason: A clinic sells its clients the diseases of the celebrities they worship.

Splice.reason: Two geneticists splice human DNA into their own creation, then can't agree what to do once it grows up.

Spring.reason: A grieving man falls for a woman in Italy whose body keeps quietly rewriting its own rules.

Infinity Pool.reason: A resort offers wealthy guests a way to survive the death penalty: clone yourself.

Tetsuo: The Iron Man.reason: A man's body starts fusing with scrap metal after a hit-and-run, and it does not stop.

The Bay.reason: A small town's July 4th weekend turns into a slow-motion outbreak nobody official will name.

The Mothman Prophecies.reason: A journalist keeps running into a shape that seems to know about disasters before they happen.

Border.reason: A customs officer who can smell guilt meets someone who unsettles everything she thought she was.

Orphan Black.reason: A woman witnesses her own suicide, then discovers she's one of many.

The Double.reason: A meek office worker watches a confident double quietly take over his life.

Circle.reason: Fifty people wake in a dark room and learn they'll be voting on who dies next.

The Vast of Night.reason: A late-night radio signal in a small town turns out to be listening back.

The Neon Demon.reason: A teenage model's rise in LA turns the fashion industry into something feral.

Devs.reason: A quantum computer that can supposedly see the past and future starts influencing the present.

Oxygen.reason: A woman wakes with no memory, sealed in a pod, and the air is running out.

The Holy Mountain.reason: A thief joins a search for immortality across a landscape that stops making literal sense.

12 Monkeys.reason: A prisoner is sent back in time to find the source of a virus that already ended the world.

Life.reason: A sample from Mars turns out to be curious, then hostile, then loose on the station.

Pandorum.reason: Two crew members wake from hypersleep on a generational ship with no memory and worse company.

The Skin I Live In.reason: A surgeon's prized patient turns out to be a project years in the making, in ways she never agreed to.

Under the Silver Lake.reason: An aimless drifter follows a woman's disappearance into a paranoid, hallucinatory version of Los Angeles.

Green Room.reason: A punk band locks themselves backstage with a crime scene and the men who want them gone.

Predestination.reason: A temporal agent's final case turns out to be entirely about himself.

Io.reason: One of the last people on a dying Earth keeps insisting she isn't ready to leave yet.

A Quiet Place.reason: Creatures that hunt entirely by sound have made silence the only way to survive.

The Reflecting Skin.reason: A boy in 1950s rural America becomes convinced his neighbor is a vampire, and nobody can talk him down.

Black Swan.reason: A ballerina's search for perfection starts rewriting who she is.

Beyond the Infinite Two Minutes.reason: A café's television starts showing exactly two minutes into the future.

Suspiria.reason: A dance academy in Germany is far more than it appears, rendered entirely in color.

A Field in England.reason: Deserters during the English Civil War follow an alchemist into a field they can't seem to leave.

Prospect.reason: A father and daughter salvage on a moon that does not want them there.

Dead Ringers.reason: Twin gynecologists share a practice, a life, and eventually can't agree on where one of them ends.

Underwater.reason: A drilling rig at the bottom of the ocean cracks open onto something better left sealed.

Repeaters.reason: Three people in a rehab program start reliving the same day, with nothing left to lose.

Vertigo.reason: A detective tries to remake a woman into someone she already was.

The Witch.reason: A Puritan family exiled to the edge of the woods starts turning on itself.

Sphere.reason: A deep-sea team contacts something vast and unknowable that begins rewriting reality from the inside out.

Grave Encounters.reason: A ghost-hunting show films one more episode in an asylum, and the exits stop leading outside.

The Wailing.reason: A mysterious illness spreads through a village right after a stranger moves into the woods nearby.

Starry Eyes.reason: An aspiring actress agrees to a role that starts changing more than her career.

Hush.reason: A deaf writer alone in the woods is stalked by a man who's already inside before she notices.

Prince of Darkness.reason: A contained siege of pure cosmic wrongness: ancient evil, quantum transmissions from the future, and dread that no human framework can contain.

Baskin.reason: A police unit responds to a call in an abandoned building and finds a door to somewhere much worse.

The Strangers.reason: A couple staying at a secluded house gets a knock with no good reason behind it.

Barbarian.reason: A woman's Airbnb booking has a second occupant, and the basement goes much further than it should.

Impetigore.reason: A woman returns to her family's remote village and finds it cursed by something tied to her birth.

Hausu.reason: Seven schoolgirls visit a relative's country home, which turns out to have appetites of its own.

The Ritual.reason: Four friends take a shortcut through a Scandinavian forest guarded by something very old.

Frequency.reason: A ham radio malfunction connects a man to his father, thirty years in the past.

Hagazussa.reason: A goat herder alone in the Alps starts hearing the mountain the way her late mother once did.

As Above So Below.reason: A team descending into the Paris catacombs finds the tunnels leading somewhere the map doesn't show.

The Borderlands.reason: Found-footage investigators descend into an ancient church's tunnels where something beneath the earth breathes with patient, indifferent hunger.

Goodnight Mommy.reason: Twin boys become convinced the bandaged woman who came home from surgery isn't their mother.

In Fabric.reason: A cursed dress moves from one owner to the next, and it is not finished with any of them.

Southbound.reason: Five interlocking stories share one stretch of desert highway that none of the travelers can leave.

You're Next.reason: A family reunion at a remote house is interrupted by intruders who clearly planned for everyone.

American Mary.reason: A broke med student's underground body-modification work starts changing her more than her clients.

Pontypool.reason: A small-town radio DJ realizes the outbreak spreading outside is being carried by language itself.

Cloverfield.reason: A birthday party in Manhattan turns into a night spent running from something enormous and unseen.

The Autopsy of Jane Doe.reason: A contained, atmospheric descent into inexplicable evil where each layer of forensic discovery deepens the dread rather than resolving it.

No One Will Save You.reason: A woman living alone finds something has moved into her house with her, and nobody's coming to help.

The Forgotten.reason: A mother's memories are systematically erased by forces beyond human comprehension, radiating cold cosmic indifference through a grounded paranoid atmosphere.

Antlers.reason: A teacher grows concerned about a student who's hiding something feral at home.

Absentia.reason: A missing husband's return unravels something vast and indifferent lurking beneath ordinary streets, built entirely on dread over spectacle.

Harbinger Down.reason: Isolated arctic research vessel, unknown organism, creeping paranoia — practical-effects dread with no answers handed over.

Censor.reason: A British film censor screening banned VHS horror starts losing the line between the tapes and her own past.

10 Cloverfield Lane.reason: A woman wakes in a bunker, unsure if her rescuer or the world outside is the real threat.

Would You Rather.reason: A dinner party's parlor game turns out to have a much higher entry fee than anyone realized.

Vacancy.reason: A couple's motel room turns out to have starred in films before they ever checked in.

The Tunnel.reason: A documentary-style descent into an abandoned underground labyrinth where something in the dark refuses to stay unseen.

The Arrival.reason: A radio astronomer intercepts an unmistakable extraterrestrial signal and descends into paranoid isolation as the truth proves far more invasive than expected.

It Comes at Night.reason: A boarded house, an unseen contagion outside, and trust rotting from within—dread with no resolution.

Pulse.reason: A ghostly signal bleeds through the internet, dissolving Tokyo into quiet, unexplained existential dread.

Prometheus.reason: Case file: a derelict signal lures explorers to a moon where creation and extinction share the same dark architecture.

Come True.reason: A sleep-study experiment bleeds into a hallucinatory dreamscape where something ancient waits at the edge of consciousness.

Phantasm.reason: A dreamlike funeral home hides duplicated corpses and a silver sphere that turns death into infinite recursion.

The Beach House.reason: An isolated coastal retreat becomes ground zero for an indifferent, seeping cosmic contagion with no clear answers.

Nightflyers.reason: A drifting starship carries a psychic cargo that answers curiosity with indifferent, escalating horror.

Altered States.reason: A scientist's sensory-deprivation experiments unravel his mind into hallucinatory regression, blurring where self ends and primordial dread begins.

Stalker.reason: A forbidden zone rewrites desire and danger alike, indifferent to the men who dare cross its threshold.

The Empty Man.reason: A hollow calling echoes across reality, and something vast and indifferent answers back.

Blood Machines.reason: Case file: a dying spacecraft births a psychedelic ghost-form drifting through synth-lit void, dread rendered as neon hallucination.

Buried.reason: A contractor wakes up in a coffin, six feet under, with a lighter and a dying phone.

Pitch Black.reason: A stranded crew on a lightless world discovers that darkness itself is a predator, indifferent and ancient beyond reckoning.

Pi.reason: A mathematician's mind unravels chasing a pattern the universe never meant to reveal, in grainy black-and-white paranoia.

Nightbreed.reason: A case file of buried selves and monstrous kin, where the sanctuary beneath the graveyard blurs who the real monsters are.

The Vourdalak.reason: A shape-shifting patriarch unravels a stranded family's grip on reality in a candlelit, feverish Gothic nightmare.

Devil's Pass.reason: A found-footage descent into the Dyatlov Pass mystery, where frozen isolation curdles into something the wilderness itself seems to be hiding.

Prevenge.reason: A pregnant woman's body becomes host to a voice urging violence, dread coiling beneath domestic normalcy with no easy answers.

Yellowbrickroad.reason: A forest swallows a town whole, and the ones who follow its trail unravel into something ancient and screaming.

Annihilation of Souls.reason: A derelict signal from beyond human comprehension bleeds into the fabric of reality, leaving only dread and unanswerable silence behind.
